title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Nuclear Physics — 2024
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Define radioactive decay constant. Write the relation between half-life and decay constant.
questions.solution:
**Decay constant (λ):** Probability per unit time that a nucleus will decay.

Half-life: T₁/₂ = ln(2)/λ = 0.693/λ

Mean life: τ = 1/λ = T₁/₂/ln(2)
questions.knowledgeNote: Radioactive decay is random but predictable statistically. After n half-lives: N = N₀(1/2)ⁿ
questions.answer: **Radioactive decay constant (λ):** the probability that a given nucleus decays **per unit time** — λ = −(dN/N)/dt, the fraction of the remaining undecayed nuclei that decay each second; SI unit **s⁻¹**. It leads to the decay law N = N₀e^(−λt). **Half-life relation:** at t = T½, N = N₀/2 ⟹ N₀/2 = N₀e^(−λT½) ⟹ e^(−λT½) = ½ ⟹ **T½ = ln 2/λ = 0.693/λ**. **Deep point:** λ is a probability per unit time — a property of the nucleus alone, independent of temperature, pressure or chemical state, which is why radioactive clocks are so reliable.
